outline: Learning programming is an efficient way to understand the fundamental of modern computing. This course introduces the basic C and C++ languages, presents fundamentals and illustrates them with short examples of programs. This course covers basic operations of development environment, input/output in console mode, numerical operations, limits and errors, branching, looping, functions, and basic object oriented programming.
